one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 会话中查看任务树、Git 变更和 Agent 产出。
one_liner.en: A floating DSH panel for task trees, Git changes, and agent outputs.

completeness.reason: Host routes expose Git, diff, output, subagent, source, context, and task summaries; task handlers degrade when storage is unavailable.

code.reason: Host registers bounded read-only routes and task tree read/write tools, with client panel registrations.

docs.reason: README describes installation and panel workflow in Chinese; code also supplies English locale.

maintenance.reason: Package declares version 0.3.7 and repository has 56 commits per queue signals.

tests.reason: Package defines a multi-file test script and test files are present.

quality.notes: Lite route; core task persistence, model, guard, and reconciliation modules were not read.
